pages.title: Tholin
pages.text: The orange-brown tar that sunlight makes from methane and nitrogen high in Titan's air, and that snows down onto everything. Carl Sagan named it from the Greek for "muddy". Boiled with water, it gives amino acids.

Made in $(item)Photochemical Reactor$() and $(item)Infrared Spectrometer$().$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Methane Skater, The Ouroboros, Tholin Drifter.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Cryolab, Lander Wreck chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Photochemistry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Amino Acid Mixture, Kekule's Dream, Tincture of Chirality.
